comment: Professor Rabe was a great teacher. I took his class as a business pre-requisite and loved it. He gives weekly online quizzes, which you can take twice so you always get a 100. The exams are difficult, but with proper preparation you can succeed. I should mention I received a 1/5 on the AP Macro exam but was very successful in this class.

There is a lot of content in this course but it feels like less if you pay attention and do the homework. Additionally, the content is well presented and is much more enjoyable because of his teaching. Exams and homework are very reasonable. Great professor and I would highly recommend taking Macro with him.

Econ 102 with Rabe is a class that's easy to do well in; participation does not matter much, and you can pay little attention to the lectures and still do well on the assignments and exams. Rabe himself is a very fun and cool professor who just wants to see his students do well, both inside and outside the classroom. Definitely take Rabe for Macro

All homework and quizzes are completed virtually and are allowed second chances. Lots of lectures but genuinely cares about what he is teaching. He is a fair grader but does not prepare students for the exam very well, and exams are highly important for the final grade.

Dr. Rabe is a fantastic professor. He is a solid lecturer that makes the course material very palatable. Tests are not a walk in the park, but if you prepare and go over the reading quizzes (which you get 100s on all of b/c you can take them twice), you'll do fine. He was always available out of class. If you are going to take ECON 102, take Rabe.

Professor Rabe sticks with the basics. The class consists of lectures, quizzes, and tests. The quizzes are a good grade booster and I found the lectures to be interesting and very much applicable to the real world. Overall he does a great job in making macro interesting. I found that the tests werent easy but also not too hard either, just study.

I really enjoyed Professor Rabe's class this semester. His class is lecture-based w/ PP slides. There are weekly quizzes on Blackboard that he allows two attempts for to get the desired grade. His exams aren't easy, but as long as you put in effort and study the material, you should be able to get a good grade.

Professor Rabe was awesome. He understands his students and can answer questions that you sometimes don't know how to explain. Homework was all optional but he is a tough grader on tests. There was an online quiz every Saturday at noon which I missed a few times cuz its at a really awkward time but they are not difficult.
Professor Rabe is a beast. However, he needs a new barber. That fade he's rockin needs some work. Cool guy though.

I took him for Macro and really liked the class; he made it interesting and tried to bring in current events. Not a lot of class engagement, but theres a lot of content to get through. Tests are fair just make sure to read the textbook and pay attention

straight forward guy. Cares about the material. Will bump your grade up if you participate. Quizzes get multiple takes so it's a guaranteed 100% on em. Take this guy. he's kinda boring but likable and "gets it".

Rabe is a good professor, he likes what he does and cares about students. Engage yourself in the class and he will reward you in the end of the semester if you're on the edge of a grade. The only fault is that his voice can be monotone and it is easy to zone out during the entirely lecture-based class. overall, great guy, good Macro class.
Rabe was a fine professor, definitely easy and helpful. Course is pretty organized too, but beware the problem sets
The class is  interesting. He is always willing to help outside of class.
Great class, great prof. Would definitely take again.
Tough but interesting class. Rabe is very fair, gives GREAT handouts for each class topic that make your life so much easier. Cares about students, always willing to help outside of class.
Prof. Rabe is really nice and gets the job done. I would recommend his class.

The class relies mainly on the three exams. Class lectures help explain the material, but you probably have to teach it to yourself again. Rabe is passionate about the subject (specifically in gov. policy) but is harder to reach out to. Less personal grader. Not an amazing class but not bad.

Professor Rabe was a great guy with a great sense of humor. as my friend said "he gets it." His tests were pretty difficult but the mandatory coursework was almost non-existent so if you do it im sure the tests will be very doable.
